newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit stays in range due to strong dollar/majors.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit stays in range due to strong dollar/majors.

text.p: The ringgit was steady in late Asian trading as the broad market continued to be led by the strong dollar/majors, dealers said on Friday.
They said the ringgit was tracking dollar/majors due to lack of any fresh factors of its own.
"It is very bullish dollar in the next few days. Ringgit could test 2.4950, but in the medium-term it will rebound to make fresh gains," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank.
He said many players were using the opportunity provided by the strong dollar to cover their short dollar positions.
Some dealers said additional demand for Malaysia's surging stock market and foreign funds looking for higher yields are expected to boost the ringgit once again next week.
They said sentiment was in favour of the ringgit due to Malaysia's strong economy and high interest rates.
"Everybody seems to be calling for a buy on the ringgit," said a senior dealer with a bank in Kuala Lumpur.
At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4865/75 a dollar against 2.4850/60 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Thursday.
